items.title: Digital Agriculture Mission Approved
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Digital Agriculture Mission with an outlay of ₹2,817 crore to build Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) for the agriculture sector.
key_points: Includes AgriStack (Farmers' Registry, Crop Sown Registry, Village Maps).
Aims to enable tech-driven crop estimation, modern advisory, and seamless credit flow.
Promotes the use of AI, Big Data, and remote sensing in Indian farming.

items.title: Unified Pension Scheme (UPS)
items.gs_paper: GS Paper II & III (Governance & Fiscal Policy)
items.summary: The Central Government introduced the Unified Pension Scheme for government employees, combining features of the National Pension System (NPS) and Old Pension Scheme (OPS).
key_points: Provides an assured pension of 50% of average basic pay for minimum 25 years of service.
Includes assured family pension at 60% of the employee's pension.
Ensures inflation indexation and a guaranteed minimum pension of ₹10,000/month.

items.title: Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) First Board Meeting
items.summary: The inaugural meeting of the ANRF Governing Board laid down the roadmap to democratize India's R&D ecosystem and boost industry-academia linkages.
key_points: Established under the ANRF Act, 2023, replacing the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB).
Introduces the 'PAIR' (Partnerships for Accelerated Innovation and Research) hub-and-spoke model.
Focuses on translational research and expanding R&D capacity in state universities.

items.title: Ecological Safeguards for Great Nicobar Project
items.summary: Discussions surrounding the ₹72,000-crore Great Nicobar Island Holistic Development Project highlight the balance between national strategic security and ecological conservation.
key_points: Project includes an International Transshipment Port, International Airport, and Power Plant.
Raises concerns over impact on Particular Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) like Shompen and Nicobarese.
Involves compensatory afforestation measures and protection of nesting sites for Leatherback turtles.

items.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) Developments
items.summary: Efforts to operationalize the IMEC initiative gain momentum as partner nations work on standardized logistics protocols despite regional geopolitical tensions.
key_points: Unveiled on the sidelines of the G20 Summit in New Delhi.
Comprises the East Corridor (connecting India to the Arabian Gulf) and Northern Corridor (Gulf to Europe).
Aims to enhance trade efficiency, lower transportation costs, and foster clean energy connectivity.
